title.zh: Hong Kong takes tokenized settlement to 24/7, plans stablecoin trials
title.en: Hong Kong takes tokenized settlement to 24/7, plans stablecoin trials

current_state.zh: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority upgraded its EnsembleTX tokenization pilot to round-the-clock real-value settlement and said regulated stablecoins will be folded into tokenized government debt trials, while HSBC disclosed its RedCoin stablecoin has 50,000 users.
current_state.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority upgraded its EnsembleTX tokenization pilot to round-the-clock real-value settlement and said regulated stablecoins will be folded into tokenized government debt trials, while HSBC disclosed its RedCoin stablecoin has 50,000 users.
